Trailer Inspection Forms, Trailer Readiness Forms and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review — I can see that a photo exists and when it was taken, but not what it shows. In particular, fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images and not as text, so none of them has been checked. Where a stale photo date is flagged above, that is a record-keeping finding; whether the equipment itself is in date is a separate question that needs eyes on the images.
